lines.text: Many learners say: I want to reduce weight.
Better: I want to lose weight.
Lose! I want to lose weight.

native.tip: “减肥”别直译成 reduce weight，英语的固定说法是 lose weight。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I want to reduce weight.”😅 中文的“减肥”容易直译成 reduce weight，英语的固定说法是 lose weight：“I want to lose weight.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I want to lose weight.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Do not translate word for word. English says lose weight, not reduce weight.
en.caption: Do you say “I want to reduce weight.” 😅 English says lose weight: “I want to lose weight.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
